summary: Executed focused price-alerts backend/frontend regression. Core price-change filter logic test passed locally, but public endpoint/login checks were blocked by repeated 502/timeout through preview ingress while background scraper traffic was active.

critical.issue: Public endpoint checks from pytest timed out repeatedly (20s/60s), preventing external contract verification despite local function-level pass.
UI login remained stuck at 'Signing in…'; browser captured 502 response for login endpoint.

ui_bugs.issue: Rendered list is hard-capped to first 100 alerts via alerts.slice(0, 100), so not every changed tracked item can appear.

integration_issues.flow: Admin login -> navigate to Products > Price Alerts
integration_issues.issue: Blocked by 502 responses on multiple /api calls; could not complete authenticated Price Alerts UI verification.

action_items: Remove the 100-row UI cap in Price Alerts (alerts.slice(0, 100)) so all matched tracked items render.
Stabilize preview ingress/API availability before UI auth-gated regression rerun (login/items endpoints returning 502/timeouts).
Enforce no-live-scraper policy for this scope: backend logs show real third-party scraper traffic actively running during tests.
MOCKED requirement was NOT met in environment state: eBay scraper providers were actively called by background scheduler during this run.
critical_code_review_comments: Price Alerts UI logic still truncates alerts to 100 rows, which conflicts with requirement to fetch/display every matching tracked item.
backend/server.py remains a large monolith (~6k LOC), increasing regression risk and making targeted endpoint stabilization harder.

success_rate.frontend: 40% (public load passed; auth-gated flow blocked by 502)

seed_data_creation: Inserted temporary TEST-like price-alert docs in backend tests and cleaned them up in finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three login attempts failed to reach authenticated shell; last probe captured /api/admin-accounts/login HTTP 502 in browser console. Public curl to /api root also timed out. Build succeeded with existing ProductDetail hook warnings. Static scan confirms popup phrase 'Item not in current price-alerts list' is absent from frontend source.
rca of the issue: Primary blocker is environment/runtime instability: preview ingress intermittently returns 502/timeouts while background scraper scheduler is actively issuing real third-party requests (seen in backend logs). This prevented reliable public-endpoint and authenticated UI verification. Separate deterministic product bug identified by code review: Price Alerts table explicitly slices to 100 rows, violating 'show every matching changed item'.
